item.title: Orbot v1.12.0
item.description:
Orbot 1.12.0 | Orbot
- Updated Tor to 0.4.9.11. - Updated Snowflake to 2.14.1. - Improved explanation of Kindness Mode and its test implications. - Slightly improved status error display. - Added simplified Chinese translation.
**ATTENTION**: The attached binaries **do not work** without resigning them, e.g. with [AltStore](https://altstore.io). Insofar, they're here mostly for documentary purposes.
